name: Famine
source:
Always hungry no matter how much she eats, Famine prefers to spend her time at buffets and all-you-can-eats. That only leaves the matter of the bill, but fortunately her second love is mathematics.

By crunching the numbers and working out the calculations, she's sure to find a way to get the most bang for her buck.

[From [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1071877822/talo-episode-one]Kickstarter[/url]]
